about_the_game:
About the Demo
The current version available is the demo (trial version). In this build, you can challenge up to Stage 1 using the following two weapons:

  • Lethal Blade (Sword): A powerful melee weapon for devastating slashes

  • Hand Cannon (Gun): A revolver-style arm cannon for long-range attacks

The full release is planned to feature additional weapons, new stages, special abilities, and a wider variety of enemies.

Supported:Meta Quest 2 / Quest 3 via Oculus/Meta Quest Link, Rift S

Playable when Oculus/Meta Quest Link is set as the PC’s OpenXR Runtime. SteamVR runtime is not fully supported yet.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains grotesque-looking enemy characters, depictions of blood, and portrayals of violence and killing driven by excessive justice.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (8GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 680 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card (onboard is fine)
  • VR Support: OpenXR

short_description: The first entry in the ARTIST SLAYER series. Through a VR headset, the player’s soul is transferred into SLASH, a special operative of the Slayer Forces, tasked with cutting down, shooting, and annihilating hordes of rampaging monsters on the surface.
